summary.abstract_hr: U drugoj epizodi podcasta Redefinicija voditelj Kruno razgovara s vjeroučiteljem i aktivistom Ivanom Pokupecom o njegovu društvenom i političkom angažmanu, uključujući sudjelovanje u Živom zidu i Slobodnoj Hrvatskoj, te o ulozi vjeroučitelja u današnjem školstvu. Pokupec govori o tome zašto ga smatraju kontroverznim i netipičnim vjeroučiteljem, o odgovornosti roditelja, a posebno očeva, te o radikalnom feminizmu i molitvenim okupljanjima muškaraca na trgovima. Opisuje kako ga je borba za život nećaka Julijana, kojeg je obitelj majke htjela pobaciti, uvela u pro-life pokret i potaknula pokretanje inicijative 40 dana za život u Križevcima. Na kraju priča kako je iz bolesti sina Šimuna nastala krema Astopic, koju je razvila njegova supruga i koja je postala uspješan obiteljski posao. Zaključuje da je za društvenu promjenu nužna duhovna obnova, a ne prije svega politika.
key_topics: uloga vjeroučitelja i odgojna funkcija škole

speakers.role: sugovornik (kratki isječak na kraju epizode, vjerojatno iz najave sljedeće epizode)
speakers.role_en: interlocutor (short clip at the end of the episode, probably from the preview of the next episode)

key_points: Pokupec je aktivizam započeo zbog problema s parkiranjem za osobe s invaliditetom tijekom studija, a 2015. politički se angažirao u Živom zidu, iz kojeg je s oko 150 članova izašao i suosnovao Slobodnu Hrvatsku. Ne žali zbog toga, ali to danas vjerojatno ne bi ponovio.
Smatra da društvena promjena nije moguća primarno kroz politiku jer se tako kuća gradi od krova. Preduvjet je duhovno i psihološko probuđenje naroda, nakon kojeg slijedi politička promjena.
Prema njegovu mišljenju školski sustav privlači nemotivirane ljude koji traže sigurnost, a odgojni je element nestao iz većine predmeta osim vjeronauka.

Najveću prijetnju djeci vidi u nepažnji i nezainteresiranosti roditelja, a ne u samim ekranima. Kod očeva razlikuje opravdanu odsutnost zbog rada u inozemstvu od neopravdane odsutnosti zbog kladionica, alkohola i hobija.

Smatra da su za pobačaj najveći krivci muškarci koji ne ispunjavaju ulogu zaštitnika i oslonca. Molitva muškaraca na trgovima prema njemu ne traži fizički, nego duhovni autoritet, koji počiva na poniznosti i služenju.

Spašavanje nećaka Julijana uz pomoć Ante Čaljkušića i velikogoričke ekipe inicijative 40 dana za život potaknulo ga je da inicijativu pokrene u Križevcima, gdje su, koliko im je poznato, pobačaji potpuno zaustavljeni.

Njegov sin Šimun rođen je s teškom malformacijom ošita i preživio je šest operacija. Supruga, magistra farmacije, zbog sinova atopijskog dermatitisa razvila je kremu bez kortikosteroida, iz koje je nastao uspješan obiteljski proizvod Astopic.
key_topics_en: the role of the religious education teacher and the formative function of school
fatherhood and the crisis of masculinity
family entrepreneurship and the Astopic cream
key_points_en: Pokupec began his activism due to parking problems for persons with disabilities during his studies, and in 2015 he became politically involved in Živi zid, which he left with around 150 members and co-founded Slobodna Hrvatska. He does not regret it, but he probably would not repeat it today.

He believes that social change is not possible primarily through politics because that builds the house from the roof down. The prerequisite is a spiritual and psychological awakening of the people, followed by political change.
In his view, the school system attracts unmotivated people seeking security, and the formative element has disappeared from most subjects except religious education.

He sees the greatest threat to children in the inattention and disinterest of parents, rather than in screens themselves. In fathers, he distinguishes justified absence due to working abroad from unjustified absence due to betting shops, alcohol, and hobbies.

He considers that the greatest culprits for abortion are men who fail to fulfill the role of protector and support. Men's prayer in public squares, according to him, does not seek physical, but spiritual authority, which rests on humility and service.

Saving his nephew Julijan with the help of Ante Čaljkušić and the Velika Gorica team of the 40 Days for Life initiative spurred him to launch the initiative in Križevci, where, as far as they know, abortions have been completely halted.

His son Šimun was born with a severe diaphragmatic malformation and survived six surgeries. His wife, a Master of Pharmacy, developed a corticosteroid-free cream due to their son's atopic dermatitis, which gave rise to the successful family product Astopic.
summary.title_en: [re:DEFINICIJA] Ivan Pokupec: An Absolutely Atypical Religious Education Teacher (ep. 2)
summary.abstract_en: In the second episode of the Redefinicija podcast, host Kruno talks with religious education teacher and activist Ivan Pokupec about his social and political engagement, including participation in Živi zid and Slobodna Hrvatska, and about the role of the religious education teacher in today's schooling. Pokupec talks about why he is considered a controversial and atypical religious education teacher, about the responsibility of parents, especially fathers, and about radical feminism and men's prayer gatherings in public squares. He describes how the fight for the life of his nephew Julijan, whom the mother's family wanted to abort, brought him into the pro-life movement and spurred the launch of the 40 Days for Life initiative in Križevci. In the end, he tells how the illness of his son Šimun led to the creation of the cream Astopic, developed by his wife, which became a successful family business. He concludes that spiritual renewal, rather than politics first of all, is necessary for social change.
